name: Double-Half-Wing Crossed-Subcube Contraction Obstructions
definition: On $X=\{a,b,p,q\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}V$, take the crossed base with $U=\varnothing$ and $\alpha=\beta=1$, delete the additional state $\{a,b,p\}$, and attach a new pendant coordinate above the base with lone lower endpoint $R=\{b,p\}\cup V$.
parameters: $V\ne\varnothing$ and $d=|X|\ge5$. The pendant family has $2^d-3\cdot2^{|V|}-2$ states.
canonical_form: The nonempty-$V$ hypothesis is sharp: when $V$ is empty, the displayed endpoint $R$ becomes a valid root.
recognition: A construction certificate lists the deleted crossed wings and decoration, verifies the exact rooted-union hole sets at the complementary endpoints, and checks that their contraction-repair sets cover every base coordinate.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. No pc-minimality or completeness claim is made because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
